paragraphs: Tom got an email from his pen pal Alex on Sunday evening. The subject was "My typical day." Alex put a photo of his small robot in the email. Tom read it two times. "Hi Tom, Thank you for your email about football. You asked about my typical day, so here it is.

I get up at six o'clock on school days. I have breakfast, and then I take the bus with my sister. She reads a comic book on the bus. The road is busy in the morning. School starts at half past seven. At school, I wear a light blue shirt and dark blue shorts. We have six lessons every day. My favorite subject is design. In design class, we draw a model of a robot, and then we make it. My teacher is Ms. Ong. She is kind, and she likes robots, too.

At twelve o'clock, we have lunch. After lunch, I play a football match with my friends. We have a small team, and we play for twenty minutes. I like to score a goal before the end of the break. My math marks are sometimes low, so I study with a friend. School finishes at two o'clock.

At home, I do my homework first. On Friday, I have zero homework, and I am very happy. Later, I play an adventure game on my computer. The game is about a small robot. I have not finished the game yet. At dinner, my mom asks about my day. I tell her about the robot and the football. We have dinner at seven o'clock, and I go to bed at nine o'clock.
I think football is a great game. What is your favorite subject? What do you do after school? Have you ever played an adventure game? Please write back soon. Best wishes, Alex"
text.summary: Tom gets an email from his pen pal Alex. Alex tells about his typical school day, from the bus in the morning to his adventure game in the evening.
